description: Source code implementing NEON-accelerated IQ compression and decompression for brain float data, including functions for shifting, packing, and unpacking IQ samples with specific focus on resource block processing.

classes.name: iq_compression_bfp_neon
classes.description: Class providing NEON-optimized compression and decompression methods for IQ brain float data.

methods.name: compress

methods.name: decompress
